title: Bach — Prelude in D minor, BWV 999

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2013/01/22-60, Jakob Bagterp). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: This typeset transposes the lute original: the .ly says \key d \minor and the mutopiatitle is 'Prelude in D Minor', so expectedFifths is -1. Do not 'correct' it to the C minor of the BWV catalogue — the pin has to describe the page that was scored.
3/4, 43 bars, no repeats. Unbroken arpeggiated 16ths across both hands.
LilyPond \tempo 4 = 80 is printed. A \fermata appears on the final chord in both staves, which is one clock stop: expectedHolds 1.
